name: INVALID_AADHAAR_FORMAT
user_message: The Aadhaar number you entered is not in the expected 12-digit format. Please check the value and try again.
notes: Format check only per BR-003; no external verification is performed in v1.

name: INVALID_PAN_FORMAT
user_message: The PAN you entered is not in the expected 10-character format (letters followed by digits ending in a letter). Please check the value and try again.
notes: Format check only per BR-003; no external verification is performed in v1.

name: AUTHENTICATION_FAILED
user_message: Your username or password is incorrect. Please check your credentials and try again.
notes: Generic message returned for both unknown user and wrong password to avoid credential probing.

name: SESSION_EXPIRED
user_message: Your session has ended, either because you logged out or because it expired. Please log in again to continue.
notes: Returned when accessing protected functionality after logout or session expiry.

name: UNAUTHORIZED_ACTION
user_message: You are not allowed to perform this action with your current access. Please contact support if you believe this is a mistake.
notes: Role-based denial, e.g. Bank operations attempting to initiate a transfer (FR-012/NF1).

name: ACCOUNT_NOT_ACTIVE
user_message: This account is not active and cannot be used for transactions yet. Please wait until it is activated.
notes: Transfers are only permitted from an account in the ACTIVE state.

name: ACCOUNT_FROZEN
user_message: This account has been frozen and cannot be used for outgoing transfers. Please contact support for more information.
notes: Returned when an outgoing transfer targets an account in the FROZEN state.

name: INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE
user_message: The transfer amount exceeds the available balance on your account. Please enter a smaller amount and try again.
notes: Returned when the requested amount is greater than the available balance.

name: MINIMUM_BALANCE_VIOLATION
user_message: This transfer would reduce the account balance below the required minimum. Please enter a smaller amount and try again.
notes: Boundary triple (OQ-001): below the minimum is rejected, at the minimum is allowed, above the minimum is allowed. Threshold is an unresolved named placeholder pending OQ-001.

name: DAILY_TRANSFER_CAP_EXCEEDED
user_message: This transfer would exceed your daily transfer limit. Please try again later or contact support.
notes: Boundary triple (OQ-002): cumulative transfers below the cap allowed, at the cap allowed, above the cap rejected. Threshold is an unresolved named placeholder pending OQ-002.

name: ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND
user_message: The account you are looking for could not be found. Please check the account details and try again.
notes: Returned when a transfer or statement targets an account id that does not exist or is not visible to the caller.

name: INVALID_TRANSFER_TARGET
user_message: The recipient account you entered is not valid for this transfer. Please check the details and try again.
notes: Returned when the destination account is not a valid receiving account for a transfer.

name: INVALID_STATEMENT_PERIOD
user_message: The statement period you selected is not valid. Please choose a period with a start date before the end date.
notes: Returned when the period start is not before the period end for a statement view or download.

name: KYC_NOT_APPROVED
user_message: Your identity (KYC) has not been approved yet, so this action is not available. Please wait for your KYC review to be completed.
notes: Returned when an action depends on an approved KYC record that is not yet approved.
